description: NaCaCeBiO₆ crystallizes in the tetragonal P̅4n2 space group. Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.72 Å) and four longer (2.95 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ca is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.48 Å) and four longer (2.95 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. Ce is bonded to six O atoms to form CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-35°. There are two shorter (2.20 Å) and four longer (2.24 Å) Ce-O bond lengths. Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-35°. There are two shorter (2.12 Å) and four longer (2.14 Å) Bi-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ca, one Ce, and one Bi atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Ca, one Ce, and one Bi atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaCaCeBi tetrahedra.
